slide_title: Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of Vector by a Multiple Matrices
subtitle_or_header: Example: Multiply Vector of Current Word by Multiple  (different) W_q   (Queries of Multiple Heads)

labels: X_2 (magenta annotation below Head 2 matrix, small arrow pointing up to cell W_43)
y_4 (these four labels repeat in each of the three output groups)
= (large red equals sign left of the output row)
12 (slide number inside yellow circle, top-right corner)
equations: Implicit pictorial equation (no explicit formula printed): Y_2^(h) = W_Q (of Head h) x X_2, for h = 1, 2, 3

Weight-matrix cell labels (identical 4x4 pattern in all three heads) - Row 1: W_11, W_21, W_31, W_41; Row 2: W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42; Row 3: W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43; Row 4: W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 (subscript reads column,row; all subscripts)
Output vector components per head: y_1, y_2, y_3, y_4
Final result symbols: Y_2^(1), Y_2^(2), Y_2^(3) (Y with subscript 2 and superscript (1)/(2)/(3))

layout.arrangement: Red-bordered light-gray slide; bold red title centered at top, bold blue subtitle centered beneath it, yellow circular slide number '12' at top-right. Below, one large white rounded-rectangle canvas holds the entire schematic: on its left a pink 'Embedding Vector' box with four X circles; to its right three side-by-side 4x4 weight-matrix panels (green, orange, lavender) each with a red right curly brace; beneath them a red '=' followed by three small output-vector strips aligned under each matrix, each labeled 'Corresponding Projection at Head N' and a blue Y_2^(N) symbol. A black bar (video-player chrome) spans the very bottom.

layout.hierarchy: Title is the largest and heaviest element (red bold). Subtitle is second (blue bold). The three pastel matrix panels visually dominate the body due to size and color. Cell labels, y labels and captions are small bold text. Red braces and the red '=' act as visual connectors; blue is reserved for variable symbols (X, y, Y).

visual_elements.description: Schematic of one embedding vector multiplied by three weight matrices. LEFT NODE: pink rounded rectangle containing four white circles with red outlines labeled X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4 (blue italic X with numeric subscripts); red label above: 'Embedding Vector of / Current Word X_2' (X_2 in blue). CENTER: three 4x4 matrices, each a rounded panel with 16 small white squares (thin colored borders) each holding a bold W with two-digit subscript. Head 1 (light green, header 'W_Q of Head 1'): Row1 W_11 W_21 W_31 W_41 (blue), Row2 W_12 W_22 W_32 W_42 (purple), Row3 W_13 W_23 W_33 W_43 (orange), Row4 W_14 W_24 W_34 W_44 (green). Head 2 (light orange, header 'W_Q of Head 2'): identical 16 cells plus a magenta 'X_2' label with a thin arrow pointing up to cell W_43. Head 3 (light lavender, header 'W_Q of Head 3'): identical 16 cells. Each matrix is closed on its right by a tall red right-curly brace. BOTTOM ROW: red '=' then three output groups aligned under the matrices, each a light head-colored strip of four small squares labeled y_1 y_2 y_3 y_4 (first square saturated head color - green / orange / purple respectively; y_2..y_4 white with blue text); a short red right-curly brace closes the Head 3 group. Under each group: red caption 'Corresponding Projection at Head 1/2/3' and blue result 'Y_2^(1)', 'Y_2^(2)', 'Y_2^(3)'.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Tahoma-like), bold used almost everywhere. Title largest (~28-30pt) red bold with underline on 'Multiple Matrices'; subtitle ~18-20pt blue bold with underline on 'Queries of Multiple Heads'. Math variables (W, X, x, y, Y) appear bold italic with frequent subscripts (W_11, X_2, y_1) and combined sub+superscripts (Y_2^(1)). Panel headers ~14pt dark red; matrix cell labels ~10-11pt color-coded by row; captions ~11pt red; result symbols ~16pt blue. No numbered or bulleted lists - all text is labels within a diagram.
animation_state: Slide appears fully revealed (no partial bullet build). A live mouse cursor rests over the Head 1 matrix near W_12/W_22, indicating this frame was captured during narration. The solid black bar across the very bottom is video-player chrome, not slide content.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray #E8E8E8 and draw a thin red (#C00000) rectangle outline inset ~3% from every edge. 2. Insert a black rectangle strip across the very bottom ONLY if mimicking the video frame; otherwise omit (it is player chrome). 3. Title text box, top center: 'Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of Vector by a Multiple Matrices' - Arial bold ~28pt, red #C00000, centered; underline the words 'Multiple Matrices'. 4. Subtitle text box beneath: 'Example: Multiply Vector of Current Word by Multiple  (different) W_q   (Queries of Multiple Heads)' - Arial bold ~18pt, blue #0000CC; make the q in W_q a subscript; underline 'Queries of Multiple Heads'. 5. Top-right: yellow (#FFFF00) circle ~0.5in with red outline, red bold '12' centered. 6. Draw a large white rounded rectangle (x ~9-80%, y ~21-88%) as the diagram canvas. 7. In its upper-left, add red bold two-line label 'Embedding Vector of' / 'Current Word X_2' (X_2 blue with subscript 2); below it a pink (#F8D7E8) rounded rectangle containing four white circles with red outlines labeled X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4 (blue bold italic X, numeric subscripts). 8. Create three rounded panels side by side (~150px wide each): fill #C9EFC9, #F5DFC0, #C9C9F2. Above each, dark-red (#800000) bold header 'W_Q of Head 1', 'W_Q of Head 2', 'W_Q of Head 3' (Q subscript). 9. In each panel build a 4x4 grid of 16 small white squares with thin borders; label them row by row: W_11 W_21 W_31 W_41 (blue #0000CC), W_12 W_22 W_32 W_42 (purple #9900CC), W_13 W_23 W_33 W_43 (orange #E08000), W_14 W_24 W_34 W_44 (green #00A000) - all subscripts, identical in all three panels. 10. On the Head 2 panel only, add a magenta (#CC00CC) 'X_2' label below row 3 near column 4 with a thin arrow pointing to cell W_43. 11. Place a tall red right-curly brace (or a '{' shape flipped) to the right of each matrix panel. 12. Output row: large red bold '=' at left (x ~21%); under each panel a light strip in the matching pastel color holding four small squares labeled y_1 y_2 y_3 y_4 - make y_1 filled with the saturated head color (green #00A000 / orange #E08000 / purple #7B68EE) and y_2..y_4 white with blue text; add a short red right-curly brace after the Head 3 strip. 13. Under each strip add red bold two-line caption 'Corresponding' / 'Projection at Head 1' (then 2, then 3). 14. Beneath each caption add blue bold 'Y_2^(1)', 'Y_2^(2)', 'Y_2^(3)' with 2 as subscript and (1)/(2)/(3) as superscript. 15. Do not add the mouse cursor.
